forms.reason: DL 142 does not apply — the licence was issued by another state. Surrender it through that state's motor vehicle agency instead. (Cal. Veh. Code § 14100; DMV form DL 142 (Rev. 7/93)) Estate record: The decedent held an Ohio driver licence. DL 142 is a California Department of Motor Vehicles form and cannot be used to cancel an out-of-state licence; the Ohio BMV equivalent is required. The licence data is carried here so the sibling state form can be driven from the same record.
